result.title: Visual Marking as a Native Reasoning Capability for Multimodal LLMs
result.summary: Visual reasoning often requires maintaining intermediate spatial states that are difficult to express in text. Existing approaches either rely on external drawing tools or image generators, or encode these states in latent tokens without explicit spatial correspondence to the input image. We introduce SelfMark, which enables MLLMs to construct and use visual marks directly in their native visual feature space. By treating the visual token grid as a canvas, SelfMark establishes explicit spatial correspondence between marks and images. This is achieved through a locate-mark-read procedure, where the model identifies relevant locations, constructs task-dependent mark features, and reads the resulting visual features to guide its reasoning. We jointly train a single model on spatial planning, dense counting, high-resolution VQA, and line tracing. Across six benchmarks, SelfMark outperforms state-of-the-art MLLM-based methods specialized for individual tasks. These improvements also persist with a stronger backbone, demonstrating the effectiveness of visual marking across different model capabilities. Overall, SelfMark provides a unified approach to visual reasoning by integrating spatially grounded marks directly into the visual feature space of MLLMs.

AI.brief_summary: 提出 SelfMark，让 MLLM 直接在原生视觉 token 网格上「画标记」，通过 locate-mark-read 流程构建带明确空间对应的中间视觉状态来引导推理，并在空间规划、密集计数、高分辨率 VQA、线条追踪上联合训练单一模型。
AI.relevance_reason: 与 LVR 主线高度相关：它明确把「无空间对应的 latent token」作为对照，主张中间推理状态需与输入图像保持空间对齐，可供核查视觉证据筛选、标记状态的读取方式及这类视觉旁路是否真被答案使用。
